name: Visual Volume-Grounded Transformer (VVGT)
definition: A general feed-forward framework for interactive and explorable volumetric scene visualization that distills dense volumetric fields into sparse, high-fidelity 3D Gaussian representations.
summary: VVGT distills volumetric fields into 3D Gaussians for interactive visualization, distinguished by grounding primitives in multi-view features via Epipolar Cross-Attention.
